description: This file is a shell script that contains a series of tests for Git's pack-objects command, specifically testing its behavior with sparse object packing. It sets up repositories, makes commits, and compares the resulting pack files to expected outputs to verify correct functionality.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, runs the given command sequence, and verifies its outcome.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit with the current repository state.

methods.name: test_seq
methods.description: Generates a sequence of numbers, often used for iteration.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files or outputs to verify they are identical.
